item.title: Opinion: One Of My Favourite Games Is Being Remade, So Why Do I Feel So Down About It?

description.p: When you Triton your best but you don't succeed.No, I'm not talking about Ocarina of Time, have no fear.I have never shied away from my love for the Professor Layton series. In the years since the catchily titled Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy - Deluxe Edition launched on Switch, I have longed for another mainline game, feeling the pang of a top hat-shaped hole in my heart whenever I look back at the bookended original and prequel trilogies, which take pride of place on my shelf.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: You Can Get The Witcher 3 Remastered For Free On Switch 2, If You Can Borrow A Switch 1 Cart

description.p: Toss a cart to your Witcher.CD Projekt Red went all-in on its promise to bring The Witcher III: Wild Hunt - Remastered to all those who owned the base game, digital or otherwise. But it seems we Switch 2 players might be able to get in on the full game for free, if you have the chance to borrow Wild Hunt's Switch 1 cartridge for a moment (thanks to @Wario64 for the heads up).As shared on Reddit earlier this week by Erik_REF, those with access to a physical copy of the Switch 1 game can use it to download a free full copy of the Remaster on as many systems as they'd like. The best part is, unlike a Game-Key Card, you don't need the cartridge in your Switch 2 to play the remastered version.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: This FromSoft-Inspired RPG Is Packed With Retro King's Field Soul

description.p: DarkSoul, that is.Has all of that Elden Ring on Switch 2 got you craving some retro FromSoft? And we mean real retro FromSoft, none of your new-fangled Demon's or Dark Souls nonsense, but something more old-school, like King's Field? Well, Queen's Domain might be right up your street.This is a first-person RPG from indie dev Freshly Baked Games, and it wears its inspo proudly on its sleeve. From the retro-fantasy aesthetic to the tough-looking, stamina-based combat, this has got PS1 goodness written all over it.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
